testcase.name: a phone that never asks for credentials fails, and is recorded as silent
the settle timeout resumes the poke and leaves the listeners alone
a phone reporting it could not join fails fast and lets the poke resume
credentials arriving mid-version-exchange do not jump the queue
with the version exchange off the wire behaviour is the one that shipped
extensions stop at the cap so a phone that never arrives cannot hold us forever
credentials that never arrive fail the handshake
the projection session landing completes the handshake
every message the phone sends is counted, whatever it was
a phone that asks for credentials twice gets them twice
an early type 2 during the credentials wait is latched too
a phone that answered something is not recorded as silent
a failed start response is treated the same way while settling
credentials held across the version timeout are sent when it expires
a phone that asks for credentials early is answered as soon as they exist
a ping is echoed in every live stage and never changes the stage
message types we do not model are ignored rather than fatal
a phone that ignores type 4 does not fail the handshake, it just carries on
with the version exchange on, type 4 goes out before anything else
a start response we could not parse is never read as a failure
a successful start response is informational in both stages it can arrive in
a finished session ignores everything, repeatedly
a failed session cannot be revived by a late success
an inbound ping response is a keepalive and is ignored
each stage carries the deadline the caller should hold it to
a phone still joining buys itself more time
